repos.title: Repositories
repos.lede: Code agnts can work in. Each run clones the repository into a fresh container on your server, then runs these checks before anything reaches your review.
repos.archivedSub: Archived repositories keep their history but take no new tickets or tasks. Restore one to work on it again.
repos.archiveConfirm: Archive {name}? It moves to the archive and keeps its tickets and history, but agnts stops picking up new Jira tickets and tasks for it. Work already started still finishes. You can restore it any time.
repos.importSub: Repositories your GitHub or GitLab token can reach. Pick one, then set its checks.
repos.importEmpty: The token cannot reach any repositories. Check which repositories it was given access to.
repos.missingHelp: {count, plural, one {# repository has} other {# repositories have}} no CLAUDE.md. agnts still works, but spends more turns finding its way around. Add one with the project's structure, conventions and test commands.
repos.none: No repositories yet. Add the first one to let agnts work on it.
repos.drawerSub: Takes side-project tasks, plus Jira tickets or Plane work items once it is linked to a project
repos.name: Name
repos.cloneHelp: An https URL on github.com or your connected GitLab. agnts uses that host's token to clone and push.
repos.jiraHelp: Optional. Tickets from this Jira project with the agnts label run here.
repos.taskPrefixHelp: Side-project tasks are numbered like {prefix}-1, {prefix}-2. Must differ from the Jira project key and the Plane project.
repos.branchTemplateHelp: How agnts names the branch for each ticket. Must contain {key} or {number}. Leave empty for {fallback}.
repos.commitTemplateHelp: How agnts writes its commit messages. An empty scope drops its parentheses. Leave empty for KEY: Title.
repos.phPrefix: The repository's branch prefix, agnts/ by default.
repos.phType: The kind of work: feature for code, bugfix for a bug, test, swagger-test.
repos.phKey: The agnts ticket key: VIS-42, or the Jira or Plane issue key.
repos.phNumber: The task's ticket number, such as AMANAT-2288. Falls back to the key when empty.
repos.phSlug: The ticket title in lowercase with hyphens, up to 40 characters.
repos.phUser: Username of whoever the ticket is assigned to, or its creator.
repos.phCommitType: The change type the agent picks: feat, fix, chore, refactor, docs, test... Falls back to the ticket kind.
repos.phScope: The area the agent says it changed, such as deps or auth. May be empty.
repos.phSubject: The agent's one-line summary of the change. Falls back to the ticket title.
repos.testHelp: Must pass before a ticket reaches your review.
repos.instructionsHelp: Added to every prompt for this repository, on top of its CLAUDE.md.
repos.claudeMissing: Missing. agnts still works, but a CLAUDE.md saves turns.
repos.deployWorkflowHelp: GitHub Actions workflow file with workflow_dispatch, e.g. deploy.yml. Deploy on the repository page runs it.
repos.toolchainsHelp: Language runtimes and build tools installed into every run, once per version, and kept for later runs.
repos.toolchainsAuto: Detected from the repository (go.mod, .nvmrc, .python-version, mise.toml, …) and kept up to date as those files change.
repos.toolchainsManual: Set by hand: detection leaves them as they are.
repos.toolchainBad: Write it as tool@version, e.g. node@20 or rust@stable.
repos.toolchainsNone: None yet: they are detected after you save, or press Detect.
repos.detectDeepHelp: Claude reads the README and CI files when the scan finds no commands. Takes about a minute and uses your Claude plan.
repos.detectNothing: No known build files found. Add the toolchains and commands by hand, or ask Claude.
repos.detectFilled: Empty check commands were filled in; review them before saving.
repos.detectByClaude: Claude filled in what the scan could not find.
repos.runnerImageHelp: Optional. An image built on the server FROM agnts-runner, for system libraries or SDKs toolchains cannot provide (Android, Flutter). Empty uses the default.
repos.memoryHelp: Optional, for heavy builds (JVM, Rust, .NET). Server default unless set; the server caps it (AGNTS_RUN_MEMORY_MAX_MB, 8 GB by default).
repos.buildEnvHelp: KEY=value lines given to every run, such as tokens for private package registries (NPM_TOKEN, PIP_INDEX_URL). Stored encrypted and never shown again. Claude can read them while it works, so use read-only tokens.
repos.planeHelp: Optional. The project identifier (WEB in WEB-123). Work items from this Plane project with the agnts label run here.
repos.search: Search by name, stack, project or group
